image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a Ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), resting on green grass blades. The wings are held open but angled, displaying the ventral side which is dark brown with distinct rows of small eyespots (ocelli) ringed in yellow/white. The wing margins have a pale, fringed border. The body is dark and fuzzy. Antennae are visible and appear clubbed.
